story.title: Authenticate into Swag Labs
story.description: As a customer, I want to log in with valid and invalid credentials so that access to the product catalog is enforced correctly.
story.i_want_that: I can authenticate with supported account states
story.so_that: valid users reach inventory pages and invalid users receive clear errors
business_rules: standard_user must access the inventory page.
locked_out_user must remain blocked from the catalog.
Invalid credentials must surface an error banner.
scenarios: Log out after a successful login.
story.acceptance_criteria:
- The login page is reachable.
- Valid credentials redirect to the inventory page.
- Locked or invalid users see a clear error message.
- Authenticated users can log out back to the login page.

project.name: Sauce Demo E-commerce Automation
project.description: Public Swag Labs sandbox used to validate login, catalog, cart, sorting, and checkout behaviors with deterministic browser automation.
project.test_objectives: Exercise critical e-commerce flows on a stable public demo site and compare generated run_spec quality across authentication, catalog, cart, and checkout scenarios.

story.title: Complete checkout safely
story.description: As a shopper, I want the checkout form and final confirmation to behave correctly so that I can complete my purchase without data errors.
story.i_want_that: I can enter checkout information and complete an order
story.so_that: the order confirmation is displayed only after valid input
business_rules: Checkout first name, last name, and postal code are mandatory.
The overview page is accessible only after valid checkout information.
The thank-you message appears only when checkout finishes successfully.
scenarios: Submit checkout information without a postal code.
Complete checkout with valid customer data.
story.acceptance_criteria:
- Required checkout fields show validation errors when missing.
- Valid checkout information advances to the overview page.
- Finishing checkout shows a thank-you confirmation.

story.title: Browse products and maintain cart state
story.description: As a shopper, I want to sort products and manage my cart so that I can select the correct items before checkout.
story.i_want_that: I can sort inventory items and add or remove them from the cart
story.so_that: the cart reflects the products I intend to buy
business_rules: Sorting controls must remain available after login.
The cart badge must reflect the number of added items.
Removing an item must revert the UI state cleanly.
scenarios: Sort inventory items from Z to A.
Add Sauce Labs Backpack to the cart.
Remove a product from the inventory page after it was added.
story.acceptance_criteria:
- Sorting options are visible on the inventory page.
- Adding a product increments the cart badge.
- Removing a product updates the cart badge or button state.

story.title: Authenticate on the practice login page

story.title: Fill and validate playground forms
story.description: As a QA engineer, I want to validate the main form and file upload widgets so that basic data entry coverage remains stable on the playground page.
story.i_want_that: I can validate required fields, dates, and uploads on the public playground
story.so_that: common form behaviors remain observable and repeatable
business_rules: The user must reach the form section before entering data.
The upload widget must accept a valid local file path.
scenarios: Validate required fields are visible and ready for input.
Populate the date picker with a valid date.
story.acceptance_criteria:
- Required form fields are visible before interaction.
- Date input accepts a valid date.
- File upload accepts the prepared sample file.

story.title: Navigate key storefront entry points

story.so_that: I can begin browsing without broken routes

Navigation links must remain visible without authentication.
story.acceptance_criteria:
- The home page loads and shows the site header.
- The Signup / Login entry point is reachable.
- Category navigation is visible.

story.i_want_that: I can discover products through search and detail pages
story.so_that: I can add relevant items to the cart
business_rules: The search field must be visible before typing a query.
Product cards must expose a path to a detail or cart action.
scenarios: Add a visible product to the cart.
story.acceptance_criteria:

- Product detail pages are reachable.

story.title: Exercise alerts and dynamic controls
story.description: As a QA engineer, I want to validate popups and delayed button behaviors so that dynamic UI timing remains observable on the playground.
story.i_want_that: I can trigger alerts and wait for dynamic buttons to appear
business_rules: Popup actions must only be triggered when their buttons are visible.
Dynamic buttons must not be assumed visible before their delay completes.
scenarios: Wait for the delayed button to become visible.
story.acceptance_criteria:
- Alert buttons are visible before interaction.
- Dynamic buttons appear or become enabled after their delay.
